newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank repo tender yield rises to 17.62 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank repo tender yield rises to 17.62 pct.

text.p: Average yield in a Slovak central bank (NBS) one-week repo tender on Wednesday rose to 17.62 percent from 17.00 percent in a similar repo tender on Tuesday, the NBS said in a statement.
The NBS auctioned a fixed volume of two billion crowns, with maximum yield hitting 18.01 percent and minimum yield 17.20 percent.
Overall bids in the tender totalled 6.539 billion crowns.

The NBS added 1.0 billion crowns into the local money market through a similar repo on Monday, with average yield rising to 17.0 percent from a yield of 15.96 percent in a similar repo tender on Monday.
The central bank monitors market liquidity on a daily basis and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 8 lacked some 1.49 percent of the funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 15.
